old_problem: Copied core-count wording and generic criteria obscured which CPU frequency behavior and tolerance must be evaluated.
disposition_reason: The Items field and opening sentence independently establish CPU frequency as the objective; the core-number phrase is a copy defect. Standard OS telemetry supports a safe parameterized case, while CPU model, required base/nominal/turbo condition and tolerance remain fail-closed project configuration rather than an Engineering Decision.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row19 all18 XLSX cells and history2634.
Preserved manual installation, BIOS, Windows and Linux recognition coverage.
Replaced the unsafe single-sample assumption with complete identity, policy and controlled per-CPU sampling; no DUT access occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized CPU frequency recognition and controlled behavior validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the installed CPU identity and its approved base, nominal, boost or sustained frequency behavior under a defined operating condition.
required_package: Operator-provided CPU/board/BIOS/cooling identity and installation evidence
Approved frequency definition, idle/load state, governor/boost/power/thermal profile
Per-CPU sampling interval/duration and expected range/tolerance
Secure OS access and health abort/recovery policy
test_case.test_command: Operator installs CPU/cooling and captures BIOS plus required Windows identity. On Linux, use approved secure access to capture `lscpu`, CPU policy/min/max/base/boost data and timestamped per-CPU frequency samples under the configured idle or load condition; retain temperature/power/throttling and logs; restore only settings changed for this case.
test_case.expected_result: Every installed CPU/socket is recognized and the selected frequency statistic remains within the approved model- and condition-specific range without throttling or platform errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires matched CPU identity, the declared frequency definition/condition, complete sampling and an approved range/tolerance. An instantaneous MHz value or unspecified 'follow spec' cannot pass.
safety_gate: Do not change BIOS, governor, boost or power policy without explicit approval and baseline capture.
Abort on thermal, power, throttling or hardware-error limit.
Use secure access; never auto-repeat a failed stress condition.
expected_evidence: CPU/socket/board/BIOS/cooling identity and operator install record
Frequency policy, sampling data and condition
test_case.recovery: If frequency sampling triggers throttling or an approved power/thermal boundary, stop only the case workload, preserve per-CPU frequency and throttle evidence, restore the recorded governor/boost/power settings, and require cooling/platform review before another authorized sample window.

source_conflict.reason: Frequency Items plus opening sentence are authoritative; copied core-number wording is rejected without reducing recognition coverage.
